_doc: Reviewer tiers per target venue. One reviewer per tier reads the whole blind bundle. 'note' is inserted into the reviewer prompt as {VENUE_NOTE}. Edit or add targets freely; keep acceptance rates sourced (see reference/arr_criteria.md).

ACL.note: Flagship *ACL conference. Recent acceptance: about 19% to the main conference and about 18% to Findings (ACL 2026 front matter: 2,296 main and 2,163 Findings of 12,148 submissions). Overall 4 means the main conference, 3 means Findings.

A top-tier *ACL conference at the same level as ACL, with an emphasis on empirical methods; recent calls ask for evidence beyond small benchmark gains (robustness, trustworthiness, actionable insight). Recent acceptance: about 15–22% main and about 14–17% Findings. Overall 4 means the main conference, 3 means Findings.

A well-established but slightly less selective computational-linguistics conference than ACL/EMNLP. Acceptance rate: about 30% (COLING 2025: 760 papers accepted, 30.1%, official front matter; long papers about 32%). It has no Findings track. Use the same scale with these meanings: 4 = accept to COLING; 3.5 = borderline accept; 3 = acceptable only if the pool is weak; 2.5 = weak reject; 2 or lower = reject. Judge against a typical COLING submission pool, not against ACL.
